what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Togo, counted by IDMC and by UNHCR, shown side by side and never added together.
At the end of 2024, IDMC counted 18429 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence; UNHCR counted 10171 internally displaced people at the end of 2025.
Refugees from Togo live mostly in Benin, Ghana, France and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Togo with JNIM from 2022 to 2025.
Floods are the disasters recorded for Togo in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figures fell from 10000 in 2009 to 1500 in 2016 and then rose again.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 to 2014 and 2023 to 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living or which routes they took.
IDMC also counts new displacements in each year, which count movements, not people, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
